$comment: Cases of conformance/regex/expected.json the Swift runtime (BloomRegex: RegexTranslate over ICU) does not match, by pattern, flags and text, each with why. The regex conformance test fails on any other mismatch, and on an entry here that matches.

cases.why: Without `u`, JS's `.` matches one UTF-16 unit, half of an emoji. A Swift string cannot hold half a character (it is well-formed), so the match is the whole emoji: write the `u` flag.
